title: Army drone strikes on US bases in Bahrain
text:
Army drone strikes on US bases in Bahrain"

"Public Relations Department of the Army:"
"🔹In the twenty-ninth phase of the Lightning Operation and in response to the enemy's aggression against the southern regions of the country, hours ago, the Islamic Republic of Iran Army targeted radar facilities and assembly centers of American terrorist forces at the Sheikh Isa base in Bahrain with heavy strikes of destructive drones."

"🔹The Sheikh Isa base in Bahrain is one of the most important and sensitive US bases in the Persian Gulf region and a major center for the repair and maintenance of helicopters and drone components, and hosts reconnaissance aircraft."

"🔹The warriors of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army will deliver a crushing and extensive response to the enemy's mischief and will exact a harsh and regretful retribution from the aggressors.
